title: Strict Bounded Contexts: Platform vs Organization
description: Architectural separation of the Platform Context and Organization Context across the entire Agent Ops Platform.
rules: Platform Context and Organization Context must NEVER overlap.
Platform routes are prefixed with '/platform'. Organization routes are prefixed with '/app'.
PLATFORM_OWNER role is restricted to Platform Context only.
Organization users (ORGANIZATION_ADMIN, etc.) are restricted to Organization Context only.
WebSockets rooms must strictly adhere to the 'room:platform:*' vs 'room:org:{id}:*' namespace split.
